transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm just here because... well, the doctor who did my insurance physical said my weight was too low. I don't really see it, though. I'm just lean. I work as a painter, so I'm on ladders all day, working long hours. It just keeps me thin, that's all.
Do you think your weight is normal for your height?

I mean... yeah. It's normal for me. I know my friends and that doctor are worried, but... I feel like they're overreacting. I'm still showing up to my jobs every day. I get my work done. So... yeah. I don't really see the issue.
Do you ever look in the mirror and think you look fat?

I don't know about... fat, exactly. But, um... I guess I do check sometimes. Like, if I catch my reflection in a window, or... if someone takes a picture of me working on a mural. I just... I look to see if my stomach and face still look sharp. If they don't, it just kind of... ruins the day for me. But I think that's just normal, you know? Wanting to look fit.
Do you ever limit the amount of food you eat to maintain your current weight?

I wouldn't call it limiting, really. I just... I eat what works for my schedule. Most days I just stick to coffee, um... maybe a protein bar between paint jobs. And then just a small dinner. 

Eating a full meal during the day just feels like it would slow me down on the ladder. So... I just keep it light. That's all.
Are you ever afraid of gaining weight?

I don't know about afraid. I just... I prefer to keep things where they are. 

I mean, if I have to go to a dinner with a client, or... eat something heavy, like bread, and the scale goes up even a little... I guess I do get kind of tense about it. So I just cut back the next day. Just to make sure it doesn't stick. That's all.
Have you had a regular menstrual period in the past few months?
Uh... I'm a man. So... no.
Do you think you would be upset if you gained a few pounds?

Um... well, like I just mentioned... yeah. If the scale goes up even a little bit, I get tense about it. 

Like after one of those client dinners, or if I ate bread... I just make sure to cut back the next day so it doesn't stick. I just wouldn't want it to stay on. That's all.
Are you afraid that if you start eating more, you will lose control over your weight?

I mean... I don't know if I'd say lose control. But... like I said before, if I see the scale go up even a tiny bit... like after eating bread or something... I just feel this tension. So I just cut back right away to make sure it doesn't stick. I just... I like keeping it where it is.
Do you think gaining a few pounds would affect your ability to work as a painter?
Um... no. Not really. I don't see how it would. Painting is just... it's just physical work. It doesn't really have anything to do with that.
Do you think you would still want to cut back on food if you didn't care about how you look?

Um... probably not. I guess... I guess I do care about that. 

It's just... like, if I catch my reflection somewhere, or... if there's a photo of me standing next to one of my murals when a job is done... I just notice it. I kind of... I end up judging the whole day by whether my stomach and face look sharp enough in it. So... yeah. I guess it matters.
Do you think being a few pounds heavier would make it harder for you to climb ladders or do your painting work?
I mean... I think I just said that. No. It's... it's just climbing a ladder. A couple pounds wouldn't really change anything.
Do you think being leaner helps you paint better or faster?
No... I don't think so. It doesn't really have anything to do with the actual work.
Do you think your self-worth is tied to your weight or appearance?

I mean... I guess I kind of already said that, too. Um... yeah. Like I said, if I see a picture of myself, or... catch my reflection... I just end up judging myself based on if my stomach or my face look sharp. So... yeah, I guess it is.
Do you think gaining weight would be a disaster for you?

Um... I don't know if I'd use the word disaster, but... yeah, I don't like it. Like, if I have to go to a dinner with a client or... eat something with bread, and the scale goes up even a little bit... I get pretty tense. I usually just start cutting back the next day. Just to make sure it doesn't stick. So... yeah.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
I mean... I guess I kind of just said that, too. Um... yeah. If the scale goes up after one of those dinners... I get pretty tense. So I just cut back. I just don't want it to stick.
Do you think that if you gained a little weight, you would be unable to stop gaining weight?
Um... no, I don't think so. I mean, I can always just cut back again if I need to. So... no, I don't really worry about not being able to stop.
Do you think that gaining a little weight would make it harder for you to control your eating?
Um... no. I don't think so. Like I said, I just cut back when I need to. I don't really have a problem controlling it.
Do you think you would still restrict your food intake if you didn't fear gaining weight?
I don't know. Um... I haven't really thought about it like that. I'm not sure.
Would you still want to restrict your food intake if you weren't worried about your appearance?
Hard to say. Um... maybe? I just... I don't really know how to answer that.
